summary: Biodexa Pharmaceuticals PLC filed a Form 6-K on October 14, 2026, furnishing a press release dated October 13, 2026, announcing that 100 patients have been enrolled in its registrational Phase 3 Serenta trial of eRapa in Familial Adenomatous Polyposis (FAP). The trial is recruiting at 29 US and European sites, with two Canadian sites expected. A pre-specified futility analysis is anticipated early next year and database lock around the end of next year, both ahead of prior expectations. This is a routine clinical development update, not a special situation.
